name: 债务与投资管理的公司间流程 (1YI)
name_en: Intercompany Process for Debt and Investment Mgmt (1YI)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item allows a company to handle loans with an affiliate company.

If the loans contract is created in the issuing company, a mirror transaction is automatically generated in the receiving company.

The mirroring change feature is available for interest rate instrument (product category 550). This means if a mirror-relevant change (such as roll over, give notice / terminate and reverse) is made to one transaction, its mirror transaction is updated automatically.​

Key Process Flow

  • Analyze cash position
  • Determine interest rate on loan contract
  • Agree on loan contract between both companies
  • Create loan contract by issuing company
  • Review mirrored loan contract by receiving company
  • Perform follow-up activities with standard debt and investment management

Business Benefits

  • Adjust your cash position easily among affiliate companies to avoid a cash shortfall
  • Shift cash easily into a company (such as the headquarters) where the funds are aggregated for investment purposes
  • Aggregate cash within companies that use a common currency, rather than sending in funds from a foreign location that are subject to exchange rate fluctuations
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目允许公司处理联营公司的贷款。

如果在发货公司中创建贷款合同，则会在收货公司中自动生成镜像交易。

镜像更改功能可用于利率工具（产品类别 550）。这意味着如果对一个交易进行镜像相关更改（例如展期、通知/终止和撤销），则其镜像交易将自动更新。

关键流程流

  • 分析现金头寸
  • 确定贷款合同的利率
  • 就两个公司之间的贷款合同达成一致
  • 通过发行公司创建贷款合同
  • 由接收公司审核镜像贷款合同
  • 使用标准债务和投资管理执行后续活动

业务优势

  • 在关联公司之间轻松调整您的现金头寸，以避免现金短缺
  • 轻松将现金转移到出于投资目的汇总资金的公司（如总部）
  • 在使用通用货币的公司内汇总现金，而不是从受汇率波动影响的国外地点发送资金
